sections.title: Beyond the Press Release
sections.body: The Kenya AI Compute blog is where our engineering and strategy teams speak directly to our community. We go beyond simple project updates to explore the 'First Principles' of our industry. Expect to find deep dives into why we chose specific GPU architectures, first-hand accounts of building power plants in Kenya, and speculative essays on how AI will reshape African economies over the next decade. We believe that by building in the open and sharing our learnings—both our successes and our setbacks—we build a stronger ecosystem for everyone involved in the future of decentralized and sustainable computation. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track progress with confidence.
